notes: Governmental funds modified cash basis; proprietary funds accrual (business_type measure net position). Governmental roll-forward uses fund balances (1,703,896 -> 1,423,689, p7); fund balances include certificates of deposit, so beginning/ending cash left null (cash not printed as a roll-forward). Transfers: Total column prints net 219,422 in (General 253,066 + Street 27,119 - Debt Service 60,763). General Fund detail from the departmental combining statement (pp17-18), which supersedes the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p11, not recorded). Street, Sales Tax and CRA Funds from their budget schedules (pp12-14); nonmajor funds per fund from the combining statement (pp15-16; Housing Authority Fund had no activity). No proprietary detail schedule in the trim. Statement p7 Public works 315,120 = Street 292,685 + General 22,435 (the General column public works equals the Cemetery department). Business-type Other revenue 22,101 is in SoA general revenues Miscellaneous (not Charges for Services), so other. Component unit (library foundation) excluded. Read pages 1-18 of 18
